uncited: It differs from [MLPRender_Fea](2414-mlprender-fea.md) and [View-Dependent MLP](2444-view-dependent-mlp.md) by compressing the explicit voxel grid representation rather than optimizing the MLP architecture itself.
**Block-wise DCT:** Divide the input grid $V$ into blocks of size $B_x \times B_y \times B_z$.
**Pruning:** Sort DCT coefficients in each block by absolute value.
*   **TinyNeRF-S:** A variant that applies pruning and quantization in the spatial domain instead of the frequency domain.
*   **TinyNeRF-w/o block:** A variant that applies DCT to the whole grid without blocking.
*   **TinyNeRF-w/o fine tuning:** A variant that compresses a pre-trained model without retraining.
*   **When to use:** When storage or transmission bandwidth is limited, and training time is acceptable.
*   **When not to use:** When real-time inference speed is critical and IDCT overhead is unacceptable; when the scene has high-frequency details that do not compress well in the frequency domain.
